entry.title: No ads in Bottled Marbles
entry.summary: We decided not to put ads in the app, not even ads you watch for a reward. Paid in-app purchases are planned instead.

entry.title: What stays on your phone
entry.summary: Bottled Marbles has no account and no server of its own. Here is what that means for your progress and your data.

entry.title: Marbles you can tell apart without color
entry.summary: Ten marble colors, ten symbols, and a few layout tests on small screens. Plus one button that could not be tapped.

entry.title: Two design proposals, and one "too simple"
entry.summary: We compared two full design proposals for the app, took ideas from both, and then threw the result away after one piece of feedback.

entry.title: Levels come from a solver, not from luck
entry.summary: A random shuffle can leave a level unsolvable. We generate every level ahead of time and prove it can be finished.

entry.title: Four marbles per bottle: the whole rulebook
entry.summary: The rules of Bottled Marbles fit on a few lines. Here they are, with the small decisions around them.
